Definition: Integration of statistics, census data, administrative data for planning, M&E, and evidence-based policymaking
Comments: World Bank Digital STP Project Component 3 (Housing and Population Census $3M) is underway; census enumeration completed December 2024. The project aims to develop an updated master sampling frame. Statistical capacity strengthening is a PDO objective. Integration with an interoperability platform is planned.

revision_notes: Confirmed via the latest World Bank ISR (Sep 2025): the census pilot is complete and quarterly reporting is at 7 of 10 target reports, but preparation of an updated master sampling frame is still 'No' (target 'Yes' by Jun 2027), and the interoperability platform has zero connected government systems to date. This corroborates 'Planned' (2); no change to the score.

Comments: Publication of an ID strategy and modernization roadmap is a target under World Bank Digital STP Project (target by May 2027, not yet published as of Sep 2025). A data strategy and action plan are also targets. No comprehensive public data exchange implementation roadmap found yet.

This is consistent with 'Under development' (2); no change.

Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: Personal Data Guarantee and Protection Law (Law 03/2016) mirrors EU GDPR. National Framework for Interoperability (Law 1/2024) aims to create data governance framework. Data protection agency (ANPDP) exists with enforcement powers. However, enforcement mechanisms noted as nascent and specific data localization requirements are not documented.
redteam_note: Only one source for a substantive score — corroborate.
revision_notes: Confirmed: the IBA country survey (fetched) verifies the Personal Data Guarantee and Protection Law (2016) and the National Framework for Interoperability (Law 1/2024), the latter explicitly aiming to create a data governance framework but 'specific measures have yet to be implemented due to its recent publication'. INIC's draft Data Governance Strategy also references data sovereignty as a goal but no enforced localisation regime was found. This corroborates 'Limited controls' (2); no change.
